text: Multiple accounts and servers on Android, with a local-only area (design)

Steps: B0 T-290 -> B1 T-291 -> B2 T-292 -> B3 T-293 -> B4 T-294; B5 T-295 (after B0, any time); F-Droid T-296 (blocked, separate decision). B0 is deliberately move-only so its diff reads as renames; B1 changes behaviour inside the new module.

B0 (T-290), B1 (T-291), B1b (T-299), B2 (T-292), B3 (T-293), B4 (T-294) and their review follow-ups (T-297, T-298, T-300, T-302) are on main at aabd89c with a green gate; nothing released. Open beside this design: B5 (T-295, multiplatform core; needs a Mac for the iOS targets), F-Droid (T-296, blocked by decision), T-301 (web parity of the pasted invite message).
